summary: A person took back a campaign's standing approval for one category of reply, or its allowance for searches, so the work it covered waits for a decision again.

key.description: The category of reply, or `audience.search` for the allowance, which the campaign's newest line for it decides.

old.description: The standing approval taken back, as it was set: by the person's unset, by a new allowance that replaces it, or by the person's approval of a search under another audience.

category.description: The category of reply the standing approval covers; null on an allowance, which covers searches.

operations.description: The operations it releases, in ordinal order: one or both of a reply and a message for a category of reply, or `audience.search` alone for an allowance.

expires_at.description: When it stops releasing work; null where it does not expire.

max_releases.description: How many releases it makes before it stops; null where it has no ceiling.

audience.description: On an allowance, the campaign's audience whose searches it covers; absent on a category of reply's.

number.description: The number the campaign knows the audience by.

max_people.description: On an allowance, the most people the searches under it may ask for, added up; absent on a category of reply's.

max_per_search.description: On an allowance, the most people one search under it may ask for; null where it caps none, absent on a category of reply's.
